stories.title: Rechter schort op laatste moment executie op van eerste vrouw die in 200 jaar in Tennessee doodstraf zou krijgen

en.title: Judge halts execution at last moment of first woman to face death penalty in 200 years in Tennessee
en.summary: A judge stopped the execution of a woman who would have been the first female death penalty case in Tennessee in two centuries.

stories.title: OM gaat zwaardere straffen eisen bij geweld tegen hulpverleners

en.title: Prosecution seeks harsher penalties for violence against care workers
en.summary: The public prosecutor's office is implementing new guidelines to impose stricter sentences for physical violence against care workers, approximately doubling penalties compared to similar crimes against others.

stories.title: Schrijfster en theatermaker Paulien Cornelisse (50) is overleden

en.title: Writer and theater maker Paulien Cornelisse (50) has passed away
en.summary: Dutch writer and theater maker Paulien Cornelisse died at age 50 from cancer at a hospital in Amsterdam after announcing her illness in August 2024.

stories.title: Schrijfster en cabaretière Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden

en.title: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased
en.summary: Dutch writer and performer Paulien Cornelisse died at age 50 from cancer at an Amsterdam hospital. She gained prominence with her 2009 bestseller that sold 700,000 copies.

stories.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) overleden: veelzijdig verzamelaar van observaties over gedrag en taal

en.title: Paulien Cornelisse (50) deceased: versatile collector of observations about behavior and language
en.summary: Dutch performer and artist Paulien Cornelisse has died at age 50. She was known for her diverse work collecting and analyzing observations about human behavior and language.

stories.title: Executie van Amerikaanse Christa Pike op het laatste moment opgeschort

en.title: Execution of American Christa Pike halted at the last moment
en.summary: A federal appeals court stopped the execution of Christa Pike in Tennessee about an hour before it was scheduled. Pike was convicted in 1996 for a 1995 murder and had history of childhood trauma and mental health conditions.

stories.title: Veelbesproken executie van Amerikaanse vrouw op laatste moment uitgesteld

en.title: Controversial execution of American woman postponed at last moment
en.summary: A U.S. federal court halted the execution of 50-year-old Christa Pike at the last moment. The judges want to examine whether allegations of childhood sexual abuse were adequately considered during her 1996 trial.

stories.title: Vliegtuig naar Israël maakt noodlanding in Saoedi-Arabië: copiloot wilde toestel laten crashen, zegt Netanyahu

en.title: Aircraft bound for Israel makes emergency landing in Saudi Arabia: co-pilot wanted to crash plane, says Netanyahu
en.summary: An aircraft heading to Israel made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. Prime Minister Netanyahu stated that the co-pilot attempted to cause a crash.

stories.title: Amsterdam moet proef met vervanging voor crack stoppen, maar Inspectie legt niet uit waarom

en.title: Amsterdam must stop trial with crack substitute, but Inspectorate does not explain why
en.summary: Amsterdam's years-long pilot program testing dexamfetamine as a treatment to help crack users reduce their consumption has been halted by the Health and Youth Inspectorate without a public explanation.

stories.title: Nieuwe richtlijn OM: hogere strafeisen bij geweld tegen hulpverleners

en.title: New prosecution guideline: higher sentences for violence against public servants
en.summary: The Dutch prosecution service will now require courts to impose substantially harsher sentences for violence against public officials including police officers, healthcare workers, and teachers, with imprisonment as a standard baseline.

stories.title: Vliegtuig op weg naar Israël maakt noodlanding, Israëlische ministers spreken van terrorisme. Ooggetuige: ‘Twee andere piloten die meevlogen maakten noodlanding’

en.title: Aircraft bound for Israel makes emergency landing; Israeli ministers speak of terrorism. Eyewitness: 'Two other pilots who flew along made emergency landing'
en.summary: Israeli authorities are investigating a plane's emergency landing as a potential terrorist act, according to defense officials, while eyewitness accounts mention other pilots also making emergency landings.

stories.title: OM gaat hogere straffen eisen bij geweld tegen agenten en andere hulpverleners

en.title: Prosecution to seek higher sentences for violence against police and other public servants
en.summary: The Dutch government has established new agreements with police and prosecutors to significantly increase sentencing demands for assaults on police officers, paramedics, and others in public service roles.
